subject: Daily AcreetionOS Update -- September 23, 2026
body:
Daily AcreetionOS Update - September 23, 2026

Dear AcreetionOS community,

We're excited to share the latest developments from the AcreetionOS project. Our community has been hard at work, and we're proud to highlight some of the recent contributions and achievements.

Firstly, our community member cobra3282000 has made significant updates to the podman build script, ensuring that it uses the correct URLs for pacman.conf and repository clone. This improvement will enhance the overall build process and provide a more seamless experience for our users. Additionally, cobra3282000 has also updated the Calamares configuration to include Hyperbola configurations, expanding the distribution's compatibility and flexibility.

In the realm of security, our community has been proactive in addressing potential vulnerabilities. Security updates have been issued by AlmaLinux, and we've also received news about three new stable kernels released by Greg Kroah-Hartman. These updates will help ensure the stability and security of our distribution.

Igalia, an open-source consulting firm, has celebrated its "Twenty-Five Years Upstream" milestone, highlighting the importance of community-driven development and collaboration. This achievement serves as a testament to the power of open-source software and its impact on the tech industry.

On the development front, Natalie has made significant contributions to the project, including configuring Secret Detection and SAST in `.gitlab-ci.yml` files. These updates will help maintain the integrity and security of our codebase. Additionally, Natalie has also pinned v0.3.0 archive checksums and added an MCP stdio server to the us-infra-hub.

We're grateful for the dedication and hard work of our community members, who continue to drive the growth and improvement of AcreetionOS. Their contributions are invaluable, and we're excited to see the project evolve and thrive.

As we move forward, we'll continue to prioritize community engagement, security, and stability. We're committed to providing a user-friendly and secure Linux distribution that meets the needs of our users.

If you're interested in getting involved or contributing to the project, please join us on our Discord server or reach out to us through our website. We're always looking for passionate individuals who share our vision for a free and open-source operating system.

Thank you for being part of the AcreetionOS community. We're excited to see what the future holds for our project, and we look forward to collaborating with you.

Best regards,
Natalie Cole-Clift Spiva
Co-Lead Developer, AcreetionOS
